templates.title: Editable enclosure and ventilated lid
templates.description: Wall/floor/height dimensions drive cavity, attached mounting bosses and bores; a second Body retains the slotted lid. Export the selected enclosure tip with checked STEP/STL.

templates.title: Sketch, Pad and through-hole
templates.description: Make an editable PartDesign Body from constrained sketches, a Pad and a through-all Pocket. Named dimensions persist in batch FCStd output.

templates.title: Through bore with a counterbore
templates.description: Make an editable stepped hole with a through bore and a finite-depth recess from the origin XY face. Depth, stock thickness and recess radius remain native drivers.

templates.title: Parametric solid
templates.description: A millimetre-scale box ready for CAD export.

templates.title: Drilled mounting block
templates.description: Drill a through-hole in a dimensioned block.

templates.title: Hollow bushing
templates.description: Subtract an axial bore from a short cylindrical sleeve.

templates.title: L-section extrusion
templates.description: Extrude a closed L-shaped polygon as a structural angle.

templates.title: Circular loft transition
templates.description: Loft between separated circular sections of different radii.

templates.title: Fixed plate-and-post assembly
templates.description: A grounded base, two linked posts and a lid connected by an acyclic fixed-joint tree.

templates.title: Plate with a persistent thickness
templates.description: Drive the stock and drill depth from one named length retained in the native FCStd. Batch runs only.

templates.title: Checked technical drawing
templates.description: Create editable orthographic/isometric views, measured dimensions and SVG/PDF from a supplier solid. Source facts must match its drawing.

templates.title: Enclosure rim-pressure elasticity
templates.description: Checked single-solid CAD → native editable material, tetrahedral mesh, geometric supports/pressure and CalculiX results with independent equilibrium and energy checks. Demonstration support/load assumptions require engineering review. Default source is the maintained generated enclosure fixture; replacing it also requires matching the source expectations.

templates.title: Editable fastening grid and counterbores
templates.description: A constrained grid controls four native Hole locations; named pitch, drill diameter and head depth remain editable.

templates.title: Uniform-wall drilled enclosure
templates.description: A single native thickness dimension controls walls, floor and lid; attached bosses and a native fastening grid/Hole follow the editable history.

templates.title: Editable hollow flanged elbow
templates.description: Drive bend radius and wall thickness through native sweeps, face-centred flanges and machined bores.

templates.title: Prescribed assembly motion
templates.description: Animate a verified assembly hinge or slider and inspect independently checked native motion samples.

templates.title: Face and finish a millable enclosure
templates.description: Create an editable native Job, cutter and checked LinuxCNC program for the explicit R2-cavity example. Supply its exact source solid; review stock, floor, tool reach and feeds.

templates.title: Moulded enclosure with release draft
templates.description: Taper four native side walls about the outline plane, then form uniform walls, mounting bosses and bores. A separate lid retains its editable history.

templates.title: Spreadsheet-driven enclosure
templates.description: Keep mixed-unit input cells and calculated width/height in a native engineering table that drives editable Body walls.

templates.title: Prepare an STL bracket for machining
templates.description: Admit closed STL with explicit units and winding, make a faceted solid, refine planar faces and retain a native drilling cut.

meshFile.description: Existing closed STL file. The default is the repository bracket fixture; choose your retained mesh before running.
meshFile.label: Closed STL file

templates.title: Editable Draft polygon bracket
templates.description: Retain a concave L outline as an editable Draft Wire, extrude it and drill a native Part cut. Edit Points or Placement after opening the FCStd.

templates.title: Machine imported stock in a Body
templates.description: Keep a checked STL and linked refinement, seed a native Body and continue its history with a cylindrical Pocket. Source coordinates are Body-local.

meshFile.description: Closed STL in millimetres. The default bracket has a base from z0 to5mm and a bore centre at[21,10]. Position the profile for a different stock.
meshFile.label: Closed STL stock

templates.title: Drill concentric bores with named cutters
templates.description: Use two flat endmills at one source centre with distinct depths and return planes; retain native controllers, source-bound hole targets and independently checked LinuxCNC removal. The supplied counterbore fixture fixes the independent target facts.

templates.title: Drill with a complete reduced-shank profile
templates.description: Retain a pointed native cutter, actual smaller noncutting shank and stepped holder. Check ordered stock and physical clearance through every expanded motion. The supplied conical blind-hole fixture fixes independent geometry.

templates.title: Place an editable Body
templates.description: An asymmetric drilled plate with an independent local profile frame and an explicit Body-to-world layout. Part exports use that layout; sourced assembly instances use Body-local geometry.

thickness.label: Plate thickness (mm)
thickness.description: Native plate length along the profile normal; the through bore follows the editable solid history.

bodyX.label: Body world X (mm)
bodyX.description: World X position of the Body-local origin; moves the complete part export without changing local profiles or assembly mounts.

bodyY.label: Body world Y (mm)
bodyY.description: World Y position of the Body-local origin; moves the complete part export without changing local profiles or assembly mounts.

bodyZ.label: Body world Z (mm)
bodyZ.description: World Z position of the Body-local origin; moves the complete part export without changing local profiles or assembly mounts.

snippets.description: Import one supplier STEP solid with the unit it declares, its axis orientation and placement, checked against the volume and part-frame centre of mass you know from its drawing.

centre.label: Expected centre of mass in the part frame (mm)

snippets.requires: A STEP file with one solid, the unit it assigns, and its known volume and part-frame centre of mass are needed at planning; the test values use the repository example and plan from the repository root.

snippets.requires: An empty Body and an earlier checked solid source. Start from Machine imported stock in a Body for a complete example.
